failure.title: Docker web build did not compile workspace dependencies before Next
failure.note: QA-DKR-003 retained the Next module-resolution failures emitted when internal contract/backend packages had not been built first.
failure.diagnosis: The web Docker stage invoked next build before compiling the internal workspace packages consumed by route adapters and UI clients.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
